final: WITH s AS (SELECT st.healtheval AS status, sc.scancount AS scancount, sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin AS gbpm FROM scans sc JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 AND st.healtheval IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT status, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gbpm) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM s GROUP BY status) SELECT status, total_scans, avg_gb_per_min, avg_gb_per_min - (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) FROM g) AS gap_from_mean FROM g WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) FROM g) IS NOT NULL
